name: Boop answers what you ask the agent to do
judge: The person gives the agent a kind of request: a bug, something new, a tidy-up, tests, a deploy, docs, a question, a long prompt, a rushed or careful ask. Boop's attitude should suit it.
reasonable: Any fitting attitude or cheek: hunting, excited, teasing, tidy, determined, nervous at a Friday deploy, bored by docs, curious, reading along, knowing, serious. A small face or none, with or without a fitting sign.
unreasonable: An attitude against the request: glee or silliness at a careful ask, fury or grief at a plain one, a finish animation, or a sign about other work.
